build.name: apt redis-server + pip install . (same container as the run; recorded)
build.cmd: apt-get -qq update >/dev/null && apt-get -qq install -y redis-server >/dev/null 2>&1; redis-server --version | head -1; pip install -q . 2>&1 | tail -1; echo built

runs.name: three redis instances; two clients contend; TTL shorter than the holder's work -> the lease expires under the first holder (Kleppmann's scenario, observed)
runs.cmd: apt-get -qq update >/dev/null && apt-get -qq install -y redis-server >/dev/null 2>&1; pip install -q . >/dev/null 2>&1; python $HARNESS/lease.py 2>&1 | tail -20
